group_audit.near_duplicate_representation: email first600 tokens, 5-word shingles, URL/email/number placeholders; URL first600 character5-grams with digit placeholders
group_audit.near_duplicate_algorithm: deterministic exact prefix-filter Jaccard join; fail closed at comparison bound
group_audit.source_separation: Source labels are retained for error analysis. Lexical campaign and URL registered-domain groups are disjoint; whole-source holdout is not assumed possible when labels depend on corpus source.

selection_rule: Maximum validation recall under empirical FPR<=1% and Wilson95 upper<=2%; ties lowerFPR, lowerlogloss, deterministicname. Final data never read.

deployment_gate.scope: Internal candidate eligibility only. Manifest remains unvalidated until separate independent admission checks.
